configs.description: AC-powered chassis as photographed - four AC supplies, SCB-MX with RE-S-1300 in both SCB slots, DPC 40xGE in slots 1 and 3, a four-XFP DPC in slots 7 and 9 (it prints DPC 4x10GE and a bare 0/0 over TUNNEL and LINK; juniper/dpc-r-4xge-xfp@3 stands in for it with the same layout, and whether the part is DPC-R- or DPCE-R-4XGE-XFP is unsettled - gaps), blanks in the other eight line slots. Every card stands turned 90, so this is the configuration that renders a seated vertical card (#899).

card-slots.note: the MX960 front photograph, re-read for #261: the fourteen slots hold the SAME card as the MX240 and MX480, turned 90 - the guide states an MPC/DPC/SCB as one 17 x 22 x 1.25 in part in all three books, and the photograph reads each card's model label top to bottom with OK/FAIL upright, which is the horizontal card at rotate 90. So each slot seats the horizontal @2 card at `rotate: 90`, footprint 29.5 x 413.5 with `opening` 29.5 x 396.0, and the 21 vertical twins are gone. The plates run y px 322-1136.5 = 396.6 mm at the photograph's 2.054 px/mm down the 704.9 mm height (393.0-396.6 depending on the scale taken), centred at chassis y 353.15; lever tip to lever tip reads about 860 px, 411.7-414.6 mm. The slot pitch is 31.0: the gaps between the plates sit 64.25-64.5 px apart, 30.8-31.1 mm, so the fourteen slots span 434.0 of the 441.1 width, centred. Until 2.0.0 the slots were 30.1 x 405.0 on a 30.1 pitch.

power.note: guide power requirements, Table 95 - base system 50 W (maximum and typical), normal-capacity cooling 600 W maximum at full fan speed and 400 W typical at normal speed, high-capacity cooling 640 W and 450 W; the guide defines typical as power under certain temperatures and normal operating conditions. Table 96 rates the FRUs, and every module this chassis accepts carries a figure on its contract except the craft interface (L29). The guide gives no chassis total and instructs a per-configuration budget; the MX Series family datasheet does give one, typical power draw 6520 W AC and 6670 W DC, with no configuration, ambient or side named - carried as power-typical-w (AC) with the DC figure in power-typical-scope, envelope unstated. Table 98 is a worked sample (eleven MPC-3D-16XGE-SFPP, three SCBE2, 6265 W output on normal-capacity AC) and is not carried. Table 84 states maximum thermal output AC 27,007 BTU/hour (7920 W) and DC 18,987 BTU/hour (5568 W) - carried under thermal as a provisioning ceiling

slot-order.note: guide + photo - line slots 0-5, SCB0, SCB1, then 6-11; the craft interface prints the SCB positions blue, and slot 6 accepts either a line card or SCB2 (redundant fabric takes a line slot)

slot-pitch.note: WHY THE THREE CHASSIS READ DIFFERENT PITCHES FOR ONE CARD (#899). The MX240, MX480 and MX960 photographs read 30.7-30.9, 31.2-31.5 and 30.8-31.1 mm between plates, each on its own photograph's scale, and each chassis carries its own reading (31.0, 31.3, 31.0). The spread is the photographs', not a stated difference between the chassis: no document dimensions a slot pitch, and the readings overlap within each photograph's own scale uncertainty (0.1-0.8% across against down). The guides' 1.25 in (31.75 mm) is Table 88's HEIGHT of the card, its envelope, and is not a pitch: fourteen slots at 31.75 would need 444.5 mm, more than the MX960's 441.1 width, and eight would need 254.0 where the MX480 photograph spans 250.2. Settled only by a drawing that dimensions the cage.
